author: centennial state news
title: City manager to host community conversation at Main Street Bagels on June 16
text:
The Community Conversations Series will continue with City Manager Mike Bennett visiting Main Street Bagels on June 16, beginning at 8 a.m. Residents are invited to attend, hear the latest updates from the City of Grand Junction, ask questions, and connect directly with city leadership in an informal setting.
According to the announcement, this series is intended to create more opportunities for community members to stay informed about city matters, share feedback, and engage with local government. The event will take place at Main Street Bagels, located at 559 Main Street.
The Community Conversations Series aims to foster communication between residents and city officials by providing accessible forums outside of formal meetings. Attendees can expect direct interaction with City Manager Mike Bennett as part of ongoing efforts to encourage civic engagement.
Future sessions may be scheduled as part of this initiative for those unable to attend on June 16. More information about upcoming events can be found through official city channels.
